fact: Before the 2018 pilot, the majority of schools in Namibia used a paper-based attendance register; the pilot put School-Link attendance capture into 103 schools, funded USD 19,000 by ADEA and USD 3,950 by the Ministry, with an earmarked EMIS budget.
title: Evaluation Report: Innovations for Monitoring Teacher and Learner Attendances, Namibia Pilot Project
publisher: ADEA / Ministry of Education, Arts and Culture
